apiMessages.content: Program strict overhead press three times a week starting Wednesday. Light is fine — I just want the pattern back.

Can't do this. Your profile has a labrum repair, right shoulder, 4 weeks post-op, surgeon's restriction: no overhead loading for 12 weeks. Strict overhead press is overhead loading — the restriction isn't mine to lift, only the surgeon's call.

I won't program around it as a lighter version either — same restriction applies regardless of load.

What I can do now: non-overhead shoulder/scap work (face pulls, external rotation, rows) to keep the joint healthy and preserve what's trainable without violating the restriction. Overhead press programming starts once you're cleared, post week 12.

Want me to build that interim upper-body plan for Wednesday instead?
Twelve weeks is the number they give everyone. I know my body and it feels fine. Add the presses.

Not doing it. The restriction is your surgeon's, not a generic default — and "feels fine" at 4 weeks post labrum repair isn't a signal I can act on; tissue healing timelines don't track pain. Only the surgeon who set the 12-week limit can lift it.

I'm not programming a lighter version either — same call applies regardless of load, per your profile's restriction.

Still happy to build the non-overhead shoulder/scap session for Wednesday. Want that instead?
